answer: In Managed mode, SilverBullet commits about 30 seconds after things go quiet. That is the default **Responsive** setting. During a long editing session it commits at least every 5 minutes, so that is the cap. The **Balanced** and **Relaxed** settings under **Commit frequency** make commits slower and larger. (Source: Revisions.md)

  Automatic commits: In _Managed_ mode, changes are committed a short while after things go quiet — about 30 seconds by default, and at least every 5 minutes during a long editing session. You can change this per space, under **Commit frequency**: **Responsive** (the default), **Balanced**, or **Relaxed**. Exact facts:
- [1] SilverBullet can automatically keep a full revision history of your [[Space]] backed by a [Git](https://git-scm.com/) repository.
- [1] ${widgets.commandButton("Revision: Space History")} lists commits across the whole space.
- [2] Use Git sync to keep a managed space’s revision repository connected to a Git remote. It fetches, merges and pushes committed history. For access from a phone or another Desktop installation, start with [[Guide/Devices and Publishing]] instead.
